source_plan.waveform: one unchanged 1024-sample train snippet cyclically repeated in complete units
source_plan.receiver_label: unknown until independently correlated and reviewed

analysis.interpretation: known-source system identification and all-sample diagnostic; no classifier training

boundary_diagnostic.interpretation: fixed source-phase folding; not a hardware root-cause test

zoom_selection.method: maximum frozen-model residual RMS among all heldout 128-sample segments

posthoc_lag.interpretation: posthoc apparent delay slope; filtering or phase distortion can also move a correlation peak
